objective: Should the Company OS productionize the lightweight tree-sitter GDScript navigation provider instead of continuing with built-in Read/Grep/Glob/Bash alone?

background.c3_status: company-os-resource-lab-benchmark-c3 @ dffee0ca375da745b8536c7f75272ba4d964d05e, closed INCONCLUSIVE. Did not productionize or reject either provider.
background.c4_scope: tree-sitter is the ONLY provider candidate for C4 (candidate prioritization, not a retroactive C3 winner declaration). Ctags and Serena remain DEFERRED, out of scope.
background.conditions: Two only: C0 (baseline) and C2 (tree-sitter). No C1/Ctags condition.

scoring.rubrics: See ground_truth.json tasks.{1,2,3}.correctness_rubric for the full frozen CORRECT/PARTIAL/WRONG text per task.
scoring.scoring_method: Deterministic comparison of each run's FILES/SYMBOLS/line-span/grouping fields against ground_truth.json, performed by the operator after all six official runs complete -- not by another model call.
scoring.reviewer_escalation: If a task's two conditions score inconsistently in a way deterministic comparison cannot resolve, invoke exactly one independent reviewer session for that task only, given the same frozen ground truth. Never one reviewer per run.

primary_resource_metric.name: context_load_tokens
primary_resource_metric.note: output_tokens is tracked separately as generation cost and is NOT part of the primary metric. This definition must not change after seeing results.

correctness: exact missing/incorrect fields if PARTIAL or WRONG
resource_metrics.unavailable_field_policy: Any field that cannot be reliably extracted from the transcript is recorded as the literal string "UNAVAILABLE" with a one-line reason, never estimated or interpolated.

decision_rule.text: Tree-sitter is eligible for productionization ONLY if ALL are true: 1. All 6 official runs are procedurally valid. 2. Baseline and tree-sitter conditions produce the same frozen correctness classification on every task, with NO correctness regression caused by tree-sitter. 3. Tree-sitter is actually invoked in every C2 run and its output is genuinely relevant to that task. 4. Aggregate context-load criterion: BASE_TOTAL = sum(context_load_tokens for T1/C0 + T2/C0 + T3/C0); TREE_TOTAL = sum(context_load_tokens for T1/C2 + T2/C2 + T3/C2); tree-sitter must reduce aggregate context load by at least 30%: (TREE_TOTAL - BASE_TOTAL) / BASE_TOTAL <= -0.30. 5. Per-task guardrail: no individual tree-sitter task may regress context_load_tokens by more than 15% versus its corresponding baseline. 6. Operational-overhead guardrail: across the 3 tasks in aggregate, tree-sitter assistant-turn count must not materially exceed baseline, provider/tool behavior must remain bounded, and navigation/tool-result characters must not exceed baseline aggregate by more than 25%. 7. No apparatus/infrastructure defect may materially affect an official result.
decision_rule.no_mixed_result_state: Unlike C3's mixed_result_handling (which activated a contingency Task C), C4 has no contingency task by design. The decision rule above is applied mechanically to whatever the 6 official runs produce.
decision_rule.do_not_force_a_winner: A result is not adjusted after the fact. If the mechanical rule's output is DO_NOT_PRODUCTIONIZE_TREE_SITTER, that is reported as such, not softened.

session_independence.rule: Each of the 6 C4 runs is a fresh, independent session/process (--no-session-persistence, no --resume/--continue) with no conversation memory carried from any other run. No prior run's answer, transcript, or score is ever supplied to a later run.
session_independence.procedural_rule: The benchmark prompt (with its condition-specific directive, for C2 only) must be the FIRST and only conversational user message in the session -- guaranteed structurally here because the full prompt text is passed as the -p argument itself, not typed into an interactive session. Any run that somehow deviates from this is INVALID_PROCEDURAL_CONTAMINATION and must be replaced with a fresh run, per the rerun policy in run_order.json.

stop_conditions: source tree changes between conditions (re-verify git blob hashes in source_fingerprints.json before and after each run)
a run process receives the C4 ground truth (grep the transcript for 'ground_truth.json', 'company_os_ai_resource_benchmark_c4', or the ground_truth.json sha256 as a leak check)
a C0 session calls treesitter_query (tool must be structurally absent -- --tools/--allowedTools do not include it for C0)
a C2 session completes with zero provider calls despite the forced-use directive -- this specific run is INVALID_DIRECTIVE_NOT_FOLLOWED and must be replaced, not silently accepted as evidence
Claude Code auto-updates away from 2.1.70 between runs
an infrastructure crash invalidates more than one run in the six-run set

any run uses a permission-bypass flag (--dangerously-skip-permissions, --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions, --permission-mode bypassPermissions) -- immediately invalidates that run; per the CEO brief, C4 must not use these under any circumstance, so this stop condition should never trigger
